CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Waitlist panel can be opened for a specific product
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: In Mochi, search for a product known to have waitlisted reservations and open the product-level reservation view.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Waitlist area is reachable from the product reservation view.
The selected product context remains visible while viewing waitlist data.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: WAITLIST reservations are displayed for the selected product
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open a product with known waitlisted customers and review the reservation rows returned in the waitlist section.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
At least one reservation with WAITLIST status is visible when data exists.
Displayed rows correspond to the selected product.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Displayed reservation statuses remain consistent with WAITLIST expectation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inspect the status field for each displayed reservation in the product waitlist.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Rows shown in waitlist view use WAITLIST status naming.
No conflicting non-waitlist status is mixed into the waitlist-only view.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Waitlist list is scoped to the selected product only
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Switch between two products and compare the waitlist entries returned for each product.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Changing product changes the waitlist result set.
Reservations from unrelated products are not displayed.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open a product with no waitlisted reservations and observe the waitlist panel behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
System shows a clear empty-state outcome when no WAITLIST rows exist.
No stale data from previous product remains visible.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Behavior is consistent for NAP and MRP business flows
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run the waitlist display flow in acceptance.net-a-porter.com and acceptance.mrporter.com with equivalent product test data.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Both brands expose the waitlist display capability for eligible products.
No brand-specific functional breakage is observed in core waitlist visibility.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Waitlist view reflects updated backend state after refresh
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: After backend/test-data update to waitlist rows, refresh the product view and re-open waitlist.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Updated waitlist entries are visible after refresh.
Removed or changed rows do not persist incorrectly in UI.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Only expected business roles can view waitlist details
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Test with authorized PS/CC role and with a non-authorized role in the same environment.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Authorized role can access waitlist display for a product.
Unauthorized role is prevented or receives a clear access outcome.
